$comment: The one harness gate. Stop hook -> checker.mjs: every time the agent tries to finish, the deterministic gate runs — red lint/typecheck/tests block on every tier; M/L additionally require tests-with-prod-change and a fresh review verdict; S is validated against its size caps. A green pass is cached by work-tree hash, so a retry with no edits passes instantly. Fail-CLOSED (crash => keep working), attempt-capped, then escalates via gate-escalation.md so a human looks instead of the run looping forever.
$envComment: DISABLE_AUTO_COMPACT=1 turns auto-compaction fully off — Opus runs a native 1M window, so the brain uses it instead of compacting early (early compaction made the brain re-ground from lossy summaries and drift off the task). If a task ever approaches 1M, run /compact manually. To re-enable early auto-compaction, remove DISABLE_AUTO_COMPACT and set CLAUDE_CODE_AUTO_COMPACT_WINDOW=200000 + CLAUDE_AUTOCOMPACT_PCT_OVERRIDE=75 (=> compact at ~150k; on Opus BOTH are required). Env changes take effect on the NEXT launch, not mid-session.
